title: Tenma Tsukasa — Profile Story

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's practice giving our self-introductions for when we need to do them elsewhere!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Starting with me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tenma, written as “soaring pegasus”! Tsukasa, meaning to govern! I am Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am a future star, but I was originally self-taught in terms of acting...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonetheless, because of my overwhelming star potential, I was hired to become a cast member of Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was even made the leader of Wonderlands×Showtime, the troupe we formed at the park. I shined during each of our performances...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And now! We are about to leave the Wonder Stage to set out into the world!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! You are all about to witness the second chapter of Tsukasa Tenma the Superstar!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? That was difficult to understand?
Was it really...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More simply, we are about to leave Phoenix Wonderland to perform in venues all over Japan!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm a little sad about us parting ways with the Wonder Stage... But we're doing this to make our dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to take the acting skills I've gained and the connections I've made at the Wonder Stage, and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Burst forth using everything I have!
After that, I'll take my next big step!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My self-introduction sort of turned into me declaring my future goals... Should I start over...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
I did fine, but it was a bit too long...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'd rather not sound like a windbag...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means I'll need something to make it more entertaining. Then, why don't I act out my life up until now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, an excellent idea if I do say so myself...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go with that!
Everyone, I'll need your help putting a script together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It'll open with the day my mom and dad first met each other.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: T-Too long?! What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Self-introductions always feel like perplexing puzzles for some reason.
